study type: Preclinical model development and therapeutic evaluation study
cohort: Humanized patient-derived xenograft (hu PDX) murine models of high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) were established by orthotopic implantation of HGSOC tumor cells and intravenous injection of CD34+ cells from umbilical cord blood into NSG and NSGS mice.
finding: Mice treated with nivolumab showed a decrease in tumor burden, but no significant survival benefit was identified when compared to untreated controls.
